World-class commercial product photography and precise Swiss-humanist typography. A tangible cinematic studio scene with sculpted natural light, cobalt blue #2563EB lacquer, warm ivory paper, deep ink shadows, subtle photographic grain, exceptional material detail. Sophisticated restrained depth, not neon sci-fi or generic AI art. Spacious deliberate composition, one unmistakable feature idea. Typography: confident clean sans with large readable headline, careful kerning, no serif or gradient type. Small wordmark 'TrackMyOPT' upper left. Supporting text is short. Show only the specified text and no lorem ipsum or invented metrics. Any product visualization is an illustrative crop using honest functionality, not a claim to be an exact app screenshot. Small footer 'Illustrative demo' and 'Chrome extension'. No personal data, no customer logos, no competitor names, no fake awards, no performance guarantees. Avoid generic floating glass cards, glowing circuitry, robot symbols, repetitive browser/sidebar layouts, tiny paragraphs. Brand blue is present but composition can alternate ivory and ink scenes. Aim for a memorable campaign photograph that feels physically art-directed. IMPORTANT: This is premium SOFTWARE launch art. Do not add passports, coffee mugs, houseplants, books, stationery, motivational slogans, flags, people, or any unspecified props. Do not turn interactive UI into a printed paper form. Render application UI as razor-sharp digital interfaces with restrained believable depth; paper is allowed ONLY for resume/letter concepts. Absolute clarity and restraint, expensive studio lighting, no stock-photo desk clutter. A single sculptural composition per feature, with dramatic use of negative space.
